headings: (500 ML) MUSK SHADES HAND AND BODY CREAM

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) MUSK SHADES HAND AND BODY CREAM
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand and body cream. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

Musk Shades | The transparency of musk reflects a fragrance full of innocence and sweetness. An explosion of citrus notes and tea leaves opens into an impeccable floral aura of jasmine petals and sun-drenched mimosa. Musk lingers in the base, offering a sensation of unparalleled purity.

Notes:
Top notes: kumquat, mint.
Heart notes: mimosa, transparent flower.
Base notes: tea, musk.
